15ACombatEnemy::ACombatEnemy()
16{
17 PrimaryActorTick.bCanEverTick = true;
18
19 // bind the attack montage ended delegate
20 OnAttackMontageEnded.BindUObject(this, &ACombatEnemy::AttackMontageEnded);
21
22 // set the AI Controller class by default
23 AIControllerClass = ACombatAIController::StaticClass();
24
25 // use an AI Controller regardless of whether we're placed or spawned
26 AutoPossessAI = EAutoPossessAI::PlacedInWorldOrSpawned;
27
28 // ignore the controller's yaw rotation
29 bUseControllerRotationYaw = false;
30
31 // create the life bar
32 LifeBar = CreateDefaultSubobject<UWidgetComponent>(TEXT("LifeBar"));
33 LifeBar->SetupAttachment(RootComponent);
34
35 // set the collision capsule size
36 GetCapsuleComponent()->SetCapsuleSize(35.0f, 90.0f);
37
38 // set the character movement properties
39 GetCharacterMovement()->bUseControllerDesiredRotation = true;
40
41 // reset HP to maximum
42 CurrentHP = MaxHP;
43}

45void ACombatEnemy::DoAIComboAttack()
46{
47 // ignore if we're already playing an attack animation
48 if (bIsAttacking)
49 {
50 return;
51 }
52
53 // raise the attacking flag
54 bIsAttacking = true;
55
56 // choose how many times we're going to attack
57 TargetComboCount = FMath::RandRange(1, ComboSectionNames.Num() - 1);
58
59 // reset the attack counter
60 CurrentComboAttack = 0;
61
62 // play the attack montage
63 if (UAnimInstance* AnimInstance = GetMesh()->GetAnimInstance())
64 {
65 const float MontageLength = AnimInstance->Montage_Play(ComboAttackMontage, 1.0f, EMontagePlayReturnType::MontageLength, 0.0f, true);
66
67 // subscribe to montage completed and interrupted events
68 if (MontageLength > 0.0f)
69 {
70 // set the end delegate for the montage
71 AnimInstance->Montage_SetEndDelegate(OnAttackMontageEnded, ComboAttackMontage);
72 }
73 }
74}

116void ACombatEnemy::DoAttackTrace(FName DamageSourceBone)
117{
118 // sweep for objects in front of the character to be hit by the attack
119 TArray<FHitResult> OutHits;
120
121 // start at the provided socket location, sweep forward
122 const FVector TraceStart = GetMesh()->GetSocketLocation(DamageSourceBone);
123 const FVector TraceEnd = TraceStart + (GetActorForwardVector() * MeleeTraceDistance);
124
125 // enemies only affect Pawn collision objects; they don't knock back boxes
126 FCollisionObjectQueryParams ObjectParams;
127 ObjectParams.AddObjectTypesToQuery(ECC_Pawn);
128
129 // use a sphere shape for the sweep
130 FCollisionShape CollisionShape;
131 CollisionShape.SetSphere(MeleeTraceRadius);
132
133 // ignore self
134 FCollisionQueryParams QueryParams;
135 QueryParams.AddIgnoredActor(this);
136
137 if (GetWorld()->SweepMultiByObjectType(OutHits, TraceStart, TraceEnd, FQuat::Identity, ObjectParams, CollisionShape, QueryParams))
138 {
139 // iterate over each object hit
140 for (const FHitResult& CurrentHit : OutHits)
141 {
143 if (CurrentHit.GetActor()->ActorHasTag(FName("Player")))
144 {
145 // check if the actor is damageable
146 ICombatDamageable* Damageable = Cast<ICombatDamageable>(CurrentHit.GetActor());
147
148 if (Damageable)
149 {
150 // knock upwards and away from the impact normal
151 const FVector Impulse = (CurrentHit.ImpactNormal * -MeleeKnockbackImpulse) + (FVector::UpVector * MeleeLaunchImpulse);
152
153 // pass the damage event to the actor
154 Damageable->ApplyDamage(MeleeDamage, this, CurrentHit.ImpactPoint, Impulse);
155
156 }
157 }
158 }
159 }
160}

162void ACombatEnemy::CheckCombo()
163{
164 // increase the combo counter
165 ++CurrentComboAttack;
166
167 // do we still have attacks to play in this string?
168 if (CurrentComboAttack < TargetComboCount)
169 {
170 // jump to the next attack section
171 if (UAnimInstance* AnimInstance = GetMesh()->GetAnimInstance())
172 {
173 AnimInstance->Montage_JumpToSection(ComboSectionNames[CurrentComboAttack], ComboAttackMontage);
174 }
175 }
176}

178void ACombatEnemy::CheckChargedAttack()
179{
180 // increase the charge loop counter
181 ++CurrentChargeLoop;
182
183 // jump to either the loop or attack section of the montage depending on whether we hit the loop target
184 if (UAnimInstance* AnimInstance = GetMesh()->GetAnimInstance())
185 {
186 AnimInstance->Montage_JumpToSection(CurrentChargeLoop >= TargetChargeLoops ? ChargeAttackSection : ChargeLoopSection, ChargedAttackMontage);
187 }
188}

190void ACombatEnemy::ApplyDamage(float Damage, AActor* DamageCauser, const FVector& DamageLocation, const FVector& DamageImpulse)
191{
192
193 // pass the damage event to the actor
194 FDamageEvent DamageEvent;
195 const float ActualDamage = TakeDamage(Damage, DamageEvent, nullptr, DamageCauser);
196
197 // only process knockback and effects if we received nonzero damage
198 if (ActualDamage > 0.0f)
199 {
200 // apply the knockback impulse
201 GetCharacterMovement()->AddImpulse(DamageImpulse, true);
202
203 // is the character ragdolling?
204 if (GetMesh()->IsSimulatingPhysics())
205 {
206 // apply an impulse to the ragdoll
207 GetMesh()->AddImpulseAtLocation(DamageImpulse * GetMesh()->GetMass(), DamageLocation);
208 }
209
210 // stop the attack montages to interrupt the attack
211 if (UAnimInstance* AnimInstance = GetMesh()->GetAnimInstance())
212 {
213 AnimInstance->Montage_Stop(0.1f, ComboAttackMontage);
214 AnimInstance->Montage_Stop(0.1f, ChargedAttackMontage);
215 }
216
217 // pass control to BP to play effects, etc.
218 ReceivedDamage(ActualDamage, DamageLocation, DamageImpulse.GetSafeNormal());
219 }
220}

222void ACombatEnemy::HandleDeath()
223{
224 // hide the life bar
225 LifeBar->SetHiddenInGame(true);
226
227 // disable the collision capsule to avoid being hit again while dead
228 GetCapsuleComponent()->SetCollisionEnabled(ECollisionEnabled::NoCollision);
229
230 // disable character movement
231 GetCharacterMovement()->DisableMovement();
232
233 // enable full ragdoll physics
234 GetMesh()->SetSimulatePhysics(true);
235
236 // call the died delegate to notify any subscribers
237 OnEnemyDied.Broadcast();
238
239 // set up the death timer
240 GetWorld()->GetTimerManager().SetTimer(DeathTimer, this, &ACombatEnemy::RemoveFromLevel, DeathRemovalTime);
241}

254float ACombatEnemy::TakeDamage(float Damage, struct FDamageEvent const& DamageEvent, AController* EventInstigator, AActor* DamageCauser)
255{
256 // only process damage if the character is still alive
257 if (CurrentHP <= 0.0f)
258 {
259 return 0.0f;
260 }
261
262 // reduce the current HP
263 CurrentHP -= Damage;
264
265 // have we run out of HP?
266 if (CurrentHP <= 0.0f)
267 {
268 // die
269 HandleDeath();
270 }
271 else
272 {
273 // update the life bar
274 LifeBarWidget->SetLifePercentage(CurrentHP / MaxHP);
275
276 // enable partial ragdoll physics, but keep the pelvis vertical
277 GetMesh()->SetPhysicsBlendWeight(0.5f);
278 GetMesh()->SetBodySimulatePhysics(PelvisBoneName, false);
279 }
280
281 // return the received damage amount
282 return Damage;
283}

285void ACombatEnemy::Landed(const FHitResult& Hit)
286{
287 Super::Landed(Hit);
288
289 // is the character still alive?
290 if (CurrentHP >= 0.0f)
291 {
292 // disable ragdoll physics
293 GetMesh()->SetPhysicsBlendWeight(0.0f);
294 }
295
296 // call the landed Delegate for StateTree
297 OnEnemyLanded.ExecuteIfBound();
298}

300void ACombatEnemy::BeginPlay()
301{
302 // reset HP to maximum
303 CurrentHP = MaxHP;
304
305 // we top the HP before BeginPlay so StateTree picks it up at the right value
306 Super::BeginPlay();
307
308 // get the life bar widget from the widget comp
309 LifeBarWidget = Cast<UCombatLifeBar>(LifeBar->GetUserWidgetObject());
310 check(LifeBarWidget);
311
312 // fill the life bar
313 LifeBarWidget->SetLifePercentage(1.0f);
314}

316void ACombatEnemy::EndPlay(EEndPlayReason::Type EndPlayReason)
317{
318 Super::EndPlay(EndPlayReason);
319
320 // clear the death timer
321 GetWorld()->GetTimerManager().ClearTimer(DeathTimer);
322}
